'''Sergio Cecotti''' (born 23 October 1956) is an Italian politician, former mayor of [[Udine]] and former [[List of Presidents of Friuli-Venezia Giulia|President of Friuli-Venezia Giulia]].

== Biography ==
=== Academic career ===
Cecotti graduated in physics at the [[University of Pisa]] in 1979 and has worked at the [[Harvard University]],<ref name=messaggero>{{cite web|url=http://ricerca.gelocal.it/messaggeroveneto/archivio/messaggeroveneto/2006/12/31/UD_03_UDC2.html|title=Il prof di fisica teorica salito in cattedra anche nella politica|work=[[Messaggero Veneto – Giornale del Friuli|Messaggero Veneto]]|date=31 December 2006|access-date=13 November 2018}}</ref> at the [[University of California, Los Angeles|UCLA]],<ref name=messaggero /> at the [[CERN]] in [[Geneva]] and at the [[International Centre for Theoretical Physics|ICTP]] in [[Trieste]].<ref name=messaggero /><ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=INSPIRE: Sergio Cecotti—author profile|url=https://inspirehep.net/authors/1014205|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2021-01-18|website=inspirehep.net}}</ref>

He has taught physics at the [[University of Pisa]] and at the [[International School for Advanced Studies]] of [[Trieste]].<ref name=jobsnews>{{cite web|url=http://www.jobsnews.it/2018/04/friuli-venezia-giulia-domenica-29-si-vota-per-il-rinnovo-del-presidente-e-del-consiglio-regionale-le-forze-politiche-e-i-candidati-presidenti-in-campo/|title=Regionali e comunali, oltre un milione di cittadini al voto in Friuli Venezia Giulia. Affluenza finale del 49,63%|work=jobsnews.it|date=27 April 2018|access-date=13 November 2018}}</ref>

=== Political career ===
In 1993, Cecotti joined the [[Lega Nord|Northern League]], with which he has been elected to the regional council of [[Friuli-Venezia Giulia]]. He has been [[List of Presidents of Friuli-Venezia Giulia|President of Friuli-Venezia Giulia]] for a few months between 1995 and 1996, with the support of his party and of the [[The Olive Tree (Italy)|Olive Tree]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://euroregionenews.eu/sergio-cecotti-e-massimiliano-fedriga-passato-e-futuro-nel-presente/|title=Sergio Cecotti e Massimiliano Fedriga - Passato e futuro nel presente|work=euroregionenews.eu|date=28 October 2016|access-date=13 November 2018}}</ref>

In December 1998, Cecotti is elected Mayor of [[Udine]] with the [[Lega Nord|Northern League]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://ricerca.repubblica.it/repubblica/archivio/repubblica/1998/11/30/sindaco-leghista-per-udine.html?ref=search|title=Sindaco leghista per Udine|work=[[La Repubblica]]|date=30 November 1998|access-date=13 November 2018}}</ref> leaving the party in 2003 after criticizing its subalternity to [[Forza Italia (1994)|Forza Italia]], and founding '''Convergence for Udine'''. After leaving the [[Lega Nord|League]], in June 2003 Cecotti is re-elected for a second mayoral term: this time, Cecotti was supported by the [[Centre-left in Italy|centre-left]] [[The Olive Tree (Italy)|Olive Tree]] coalition.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.repubblica.it/online/politica/elezgiugno/udin/udin.html?ref=search|title=Anche Udine al centrosinistra: si completa la debacle del Polo|work=[[La Repubblica]]|date=11 June 2003|access-date=13 November 2018}}</ref> Cecotti held his seat for 10 years overall. On 14 February 2007 Cecotti decided to transform Convergence for Udine into a regional party, called '''Convergence for Friuli''' (''Convergenza per il Friuli''). The party was represented in the [[Regional Council of Friuli-Venezia Giulia]] by Mario Puiatti, elected in 2003 for the Greens.

In 2018, Cecotti founded the political movement [[Pact for Autonomy]],<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ilfriuli.it/articolo/Politica/Cecotti-points-_ecco_il_mio_programma_per_salvare_la_Regione/3/178840|title=Cecotti: ecco il mio programma per salvare la Regione|work=ilfriuli.it|date=1 April 2018|access-date=13 November 2018}}</ref> an [[Autonomism (political doctrine)|autonomism]] [[List of political parties in Friuli-Venezia Giulia|political party in Friuli-Venezia Giulia]], which aims to protect all [[linguistic minorities]] in the region, and with which he ran again for the office of [[List of Presidents of Friuli-Venezia Giulia|President of Friuli-Venezia Giulia]] at the [[2018 Friuli-Venezia Giulia regional election|2018 regional election]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.repubblica.it/politica/2018/04/28/news/elezioni_friuli_venezia_giulia-195046556/?ref=search|title=Elezioni in Friuli Venezia Giulia: affluenza finale al 49,63%|work=[[La Repubblica]]|date=29 April 2018|access-date=13 November 2018}}</ref> ranking fourth.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ilpost.it/2018/04/30/regionali-friuli-venezia-giulia/|title=In Friuli Venezia Giulia ha stravinto il centrodestra|work=[[Il Post]]|date=30 April 2018|access-date=13 November 2018}}</ref>
